record.dic_text:
03929 Lemek {leh'-mek}

字根已不使用, 意義不明確 ; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Lamech 11; 11

拉麥 = "強而有力的"
1) 該隱的第五代子孫, 亞大和洗拉的丈夫, 雅八、猶八、土八該隱及拿瑪的父親
2) 挪亞的父親
record.edic_text:
03929 Lemek {leh'-mek}

from an unused root of uncertain meaning;; n pr m

AV - Lamech 11; 11

Lamech = "powerful"
1) the 5th lineal descendant from Cain, husband of Adah and Zillah,
   father of sons, Jabal, Jubal, and Tubal-cain, and daughter, Naamah
2) father of Noah
